instruction: A king crab assembled from folded cardstock polygons with visible glue tabs and crisp crease lines along every joint. The domed carapace is coral-orange matte paper with printed speckles, while the eight walking legs and two chunky claws are made of narrow tapered paper cones. Two paper-punch eyes sit on short cylindrical stalks.
